label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Toll has risen steadily from 132 (Aug 10) to 329 as of the president's balance cut off 18:30 Aug 21; international outlets (DW) report the same figure.

label: Injured
contestNote: Wikipedia/AP cite a slightly higher 4,613 (4,611 in Colombia, 2 in Panama); presidential balance holds at 4,600 as of Aug 21 cutoff.

label: Missing
contestNote: Early estimates ran as high as 420; narrowed from 260+ (Aug 20) to 247 in the president's Aug 21-cutoff balance, though a same-day Infobae report cited 234 — agencies have not fully reconciled the count.

label: Structures Destroyed
contestNote: Refined from the 30,000+ round estimate (Aug 20) to a precise 31,183 destroyed / 171,273 damaged-but-standing homes, plus 553 buildings collapsed and 5,755 damaged, as the assessment covers all 481 affected municipios.

label: Departments Affected
contestNote: Decree 1261 (Aug 19) named 15 departments under the economic emergency; the president's Aug 21-cutoff balance references 16 departments and 481 municipios, reopening the earlier resolved count pending clarification of which department was added.

label: Reconstruction Cost Estimate
contestNote: Estimates range from Oxford Economics' $1–2B to USGS's ~$40B (7% of GDP) — a 20x spread.

label: Aftershocks Recorded
contestNote: New shallow aftershocks continue near the epicentral zone — M3.1 in Istmina, Chocó the evening of Aug 22, then M2.6 (06:50) and M2.8 (07:49) on Aug 23 — though SGC has not published an updated running total since 325+ (Aug 17).
